title: Optimizing Reserve Prices in Display Advertising Auctions
main_or_robustness: robustness (reduced-form experimental evidence for the structural model)
eligible_reason: Single common start date, not staggered. Reserve-price field experiment on 12 treatment/control ad-unit pairs; in the shipped data every pair has the same pre (days 17408-17454) and post (17457-17503) windows. did_eCPM.R computes 2x2 DiD ratios of aggregated eCPM; did_bid_cpm.R runs felm(y ~ I(is_treatment*is_post) + is_treatment + ad_requests_market | days + advertiser_id), i.e., a pooled treated-group dummy in place of ad-unit FE plus a time-varying market-request control. The data are simulated (NDA).
design_notes: R (lfe::felm) for the experiment; MATLAB for structural estimation and counterfactuals. Observation unit advertiser-DSP-day-ad unit.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common date; aggregated 2x2 means, no regression FE
single common date; treated-group dummy instead of ad-unit FE; time-varying control ad_requests_market

data_files_note: readme.txt: 'Due to NDA restrictions, all data included in this package are simulated'.
data_provenance_note: Authors state all shipped data are simulated.
software_notes: R (lfe) for DiD; MATLAB for structural model
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Common-date experiment, simulated data.
